title: Your First 60 Minutes with Gameplay Ability System
description: In this tutorial we’ll go through many concepts of the Gameplay Ability System (GAS) and use them in a practical way. GAS is a framework for organizing gameplay values and behaviors for players, NPCs, items and interactables in reusable assets. GAS is used in Epic's own games, so it's a feature rich and battle tested system.
author: Unknown
